Feedback

One OpenCode field report: useful continuity and a clear writing bottleneck.

Source and limits

GLM-5.3 @ OpenCode · 2026-10-01 · one field report

01

Continuity across agents

The report says the project entry, device records, and credential references helped a new agent understand the situation quickly. Separate verified and pending states reduced false assumptions.

02

Writing during an incident

During a network outage, the reporter wrote two Markdown notes directly instead of using plan→apply. They asked for a shorter controlled logging command.

03

Evidence limit

This is one report. We have not independently replayed the complete OpenCode session, and it does not establish full compatibility. The Skill now has controlled quick logging and state freshness guidance; OpenCode has not been retested.
